inputs.text: The protest at Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday is a warning, not random unrest. The National Assembly’s “reform” bills look like a power grab packaged as routine change, and the alarms from both the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations suggest the people selling this agenda know workers and the public will bear the cost. Calling it reform may just be how they disguise who gains control.
